pairs.why: Both coffins have soft, outline-free edges with similar bevels, and the edges give no reason to prefer one.
A's thick rope has broad, soft twist grooves, while B's fine dense twist lines add more small edges than the smooth real cards show.
A's hat has a crisp, high-contrast silhouette against the background like the real cap and binoculars, while B's dark brim edge melts into soft shading.
B's rope has fewer, bolder twist edges and a smooth silhouette, while A's fine twist lines make the edge density busier than the real cards.
A has a thick carved frame, clear panel grooves and dense ivy edges around the door, closer to the real card's edge density than B's thinner, sparser treatment.
A's chunky tubes and padded canvas have soft, thick contours like the real chair, while B's thin wire-like tubes read as hard, thin lines.
Both telescopes have clean outline-free edges with similar crisp rims, and nothing in the linework separates them.
B's larger, chunkier stone forms have clearer edges with some cracked veining, while A's thin slab edges are weaker.
